views.label: Hero
views.note: The default: every square counting in step, the rows rolling up the tube, the torus turning sideways once in 44 seconds.

views.label: Detail, 2.5×
views.note: The front of the tube mid-beat: each digit rolls up out of its square as the next rolls in, clipped on the surface.

views.label: Detail, 3.5×
views.note: Into the hole, where the horn torus closes to a point and the squares and digits shrink and bend with it.

views.label: Wave
views.note: The digits change in a diagonal wave instead of all at once.

views.label: Cascade
views.note: Each square changes at its own moment in the beat.

views.label: Flip
views.note: Each digit flips over to the next instead of rolling.

views.label: Over
views.note: The torus turns end over end, showing its hole face on and then its underside.
Sideways and over at once, at four times the speed so one loop takes 33 seconds.

views.label: Turn off
views.note: The torus held at the isometric angle; only the rows and digits move, one loop in 11 seconds.
